import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (sc.hasNextLong()) {
            long x = sc.nextLong();
            long y = sc.nextLong();
            long limit = sc.nextLong();
            
            long num, den, big, small, rem = 1, quot;
            float best, err;

            if (y <= limit) {
                num = x;
                den = y;
            } else {
                best = 1.0f;
                for (long i = 1; i <= limit; i++) {
                    quot = i * x / y;

                    err = (float)((double)x / (double)y - (double)quot / (double)i);
                    if (err < best) {
                        best = err;
                        num = quot;
                        den = i;
                    }

                    err = (float)((double)(quot + 1) / (double)i - (double)x / (double)y);
                    if (err < best) {
                        best = err;
                        num = quot + 1;
                        den = i;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (num > den) {
                big = num;
                small = den;
            } else {
                big = den;
                small = num;
            }

            if (small == 0) {
                big = 1;
            } else {
                while (small != 0) {
                    rem = big % small;
                    big = small;
                    small = rem;
                }
            }

            if (rem != 1) {
                num /= big;
                den /= big;
            }

            System.out.println(num + "/" + den);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
